You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Leo Schumacher. Barber. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Carpenter's square, Coat button, Wedding ring, Photo album, Dispatcher's headset. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people.
